_note: COLE'S SONIC BOOM. Mike, 2026-09-17: 'I also need Cole's Sonic Wave/Boom to be upgraded and
feel/sound and work like a deadly sonic sound attack.'
Measured before writing a prompt: sonicRelease() builds its own sound function (coleSonicBoom /
sonicBoomFull / sonicBoomHalf) into a local called fn and NEVER CALLS IT - only the generic
colePressureRelease feedback plays. The dedicated release has been registered, TAME-gated and
silent since it landed. That is half of 'does not feel deadly' before any new sample.
SECOND CUT. The first pair was REFUSED by the gate as pure bass (0.016 and 0.006 of energy above
2 kHz against 0.08) even with the crack named first - 'sonic boom' and 'sub-bass thump' pulled
the whole render down, and the half cue also swelled in (transient at 48%). So the subject is
now a SHRILL sonic screech - a bright, glassy, piercing thing - with the thump demoted to a
short afterthought and sub-bass forbidden outright. Both class 'impact'.
